newsitem.title: USA: Nortek sets buyback of up to 500,000 shares.
newsitem.headline: Nortek sets buyback of up to 500,000 shares.

text.p: Nortek Inc said Wednesday directors authorized an additional common stock repurchase program of up to 500,000 shares.
The timing of the purchases will be dictated by overall market conditions, cash availability and provisions of the company's outstanding debt instruments.

Chief executive Richard L. Bready said the board is continuing the stock buyback program "in the belief that the price level of Nortek's common stock still does not reflect the current or potential value of the company.

"Accordingly" he said, "this is a good long-term investment for the company. The program will also mitigate the effects of the issuance of common stock under current stock options and awards programs."

Since initiating the current series of repurchase programs in November of 1995, Nortek said, it has bought back in excess of 2.8 million common shares. It has about 9.6 million shares outstanding. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
